description: This file defines the CubeWallpaper2Settings class, which extends PreferenceActivity to manage user preferences for a live wallpaper in an Android application. It handles loading preferences from a resource, registering, and unregistering preference change listeners.

classes.name: CubeWallpaper2Settings
classes.description: A preference activity for configuring settings related to the live cube wallpaper.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the preference activity, sets preference file name, loads preferences from resource, and registers change listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Placeholder for actions when activity resumes; currently calls super without additional logic.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters preference change listener when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Callback method invoked when shared preferences change; currently empty.
